script_text: Leo, Saturn is planting a flag in your 10th House of Career, and Fire energy will NOT let you sit this one out. The Sun, your ruling planet, is forming a powerful trine to Jupiter in your 2nd House of Wealth, while Mercury squares Neptune in your 8th House — meaning hidden truths about money and shared resources are surfacing. In love, Venus in your 5th House of Romance is sextile Mars, igniting a magnetic attraction you cannot deny — if you're single, this raw energy pulls someone bold and passionate toward you. For career and money, this trine to Jupiter signals an unexpected financial opportunity tied to creative work — trust it. Warning: do not let ego override collaboration today, or a partnership you value will fracture under pressure. Subscribe so you don't miss what the stars hold for Leo this week.
